title: Mittelhaw High
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: Input: Thrust, Right, Right, Left. Follow a thrust with two quick right cuts, then cut from the left into the opponent's neck.
second_page: A heavy blow to the neck can often end a fight with a single strike.

zh_cn.title: 高位横批
zh_cn.first_page: 输入：刺、右、右、左。直刺、两次快速右斩后，以左斩切向对手颈部。
zh_cn.second_page: 一击对于颈部的重击，多数情况能一击致命。翻到这里，你已经开始练习高位横批。
